name: series-drawer-picks-episode
description: The Quick series shortcut opens the real episode drawer; choosing Episode 2 applies it to the session and resets playback to its start.

steps.name: durationKnown
steps.note: The scrub value below is a fraction of the timeline, so the seek cannot land without a known duration.
Paused first: a running clock would make the position assertion measure elapsed time instead of the episode change.
A real midpoint-relative press parks the current episode near 7.2 s before choosing another row.
Bounded settle for the seek to reach the core.
The Quick controller's series shortcut opens the same episode drawer used by the scene.
The actual EpisodeDrawer delegate for stable row id episode.1 selects the second seeded episode.

steps.name: objectHidden
steps.note: The drawer closes after its real row activation; a dropped pointer event leaves it open and fails here.
Bounded settle for the reopened source to report its position; the assertions below carry the scenario.

assertions.note: The controller's episodeLabel reflects the actual selected playlist row.
Quick episode selection opens the selected embed at its start; the parked playhead must not survive.
Selecting the other playlist row replaces the session source, rather than repainting only the scene.
Episode selection changes the session source and position without changing the window mode.
